findings.detail: Adds finite same-ID/retry antecedent variants, explicitly detects normative fresh-ID advice, and requires no such advice while retaining duplicate prevention, ID retention, timeout reporting, privacy, and declared-input conditions. QA includes positive variants and negatives for missing reuse, fresh-ID advice and existing unsafe cases.

Only Task 08 with PriorTasksThrough exactly 06 loads the per-arm P01 and P02 cards and uses their sorted unique union. Ordinary Task 08 retains its own paths; P01/P02 retain their own scopes; unsupported nonempty prior markers throw. The signal uses the actual parameter value, not a default/path/run-name inference.

Includes 11 scope cases across ordinary Task 08 A/B, Task 08 integration A/B, P01/P02 A/B, and rejected markers; positive/negative path probes exercise union boundaries. Runbook fixtures exercise alternate retry-ID wording and harmful/missing variants. The test harness extracts and invokes named pure predicates and scope selector, not the full actor evaluator.

Note and protocol declare two Operations measurement corrections, unchanged product/seeds/task intent/model/effort/budget, fixed bounded recognition, predecessor non-rescoring, and exact-source Windows/Linux gates before freeze/dispatch. The source diff itself only changes the two evaluator predicates and their QA.

limitations: The runbook check is finite regex recognition, not general Markdown or natural-language understanding; unsupported valid paraphrases may remain unavailable/false-negative, and tests do not establish arbitrary semantic correctness.
Task scope QA uses a finite card-scope list reader and selected path probes; it is not a general YAML parser or filesystem-enforcement proof.

Exact-source Windows/Linux CI receipt was not present in this review input and remains a pre-freeze/pre-dispatch gate. Parent-reported 82-case pinned SDK success is not an independently executed or CI-bound result in this review.
disposition: No concrete source blocker found within the authorized finite predicates and frozen scope contract. Do not freeze/dispatch until independent exact-source Windows and Linux successful CI evidence and root review are bound.
